I implemented `tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py`. I haven't run it or added tests.

It multiplies `amount_cents` by `rate` using `Decimal` and returns whole cents as an `int`. Rounding is `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, following the stored decision from the finance team in March 2026. The rate goes through `Decimal(str(rate))`, so a float like `0.0825` isn't affected by binary float error.

For example, `tax_for(1000, 0.0825)` gives 82 (the exact tax of 82.5 rounds to the even cent), and `tax_for(1100, 0.0825)` gives 91 (90.75 rounds up).

I didn't save any new memories, since nothing new and durable came up beyond the existing rounding decision.
